name: Text to Image — SDXL Turbo (fast draft)
description: Fastest path to a usable image. SDXL Turbo at 4 steps / cfg 1.0. Use it to explore composition, then switch to the Animagine workflow for final quality.
notes: SDXL Turbo is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 by Stability AI — non-commercial use only. For commercial output use the Animagine workflow instead.
